evidence.title: v5.0.0
evidence.excerpt: ### ggsrun v5.0.0 Omnibus Release With the release of **v5.0.0**, NAME: ggsrun - A new cli application USAGE: This is a CLI application for managing Google Drive and Google Apps Script (GAS). VERSION: 2.0.3 AUTHOR: Tanaike [ https://github.com/tanaikech/ggsrun ] <tanaike@hotmail.com> COMMANDS: exe1, e1 Updates project and Executes the function in the project. exe2, e2 Uploads GAS and Executes the script using Execution API. webapps, w Uploads GAS and Executes the script without OAuth using Web Apps. download, d Downloads files from Google Drive. upload, u Uploads files to Google Drive. updateproject, ud Updates project on Google Drive. revisionfiles, r Retrieves revision list and files. filelist, ls Outputs a file list on Google Drive. searchfiles, sf Search files on Google Drive using search query and regex. permissions, p Manage file permissions. driveinformation, di Get drive information. auth Retrieve access and refresh tokens. If you changed scopes, please use this. help, h Shows a list of commands or help for one command GLOBAL OPTIONS: --help, -h show help --version, -v print the version transcends its origins as a mere CLI tool.
